datasets.title: Data from visits to the trough of Nellore cattle

primary_publication.title: socialh: An R package for determining the social hierarchy of animals using data from individual electronic bins

study.population: Nellore males in a feed-efficiency trial
study.diet: Total mixed ration; fed at 08:00 and 15:00
study.measurement: GrowSafe electronic feeder identification and entry/exit times

datasets.label_scope: Electronic feed-bin visits. The public Kaggle file has no measured intake, behavior ethogram, water visits, GPS, or pasture position.
provenance_notes: The article reports that its underlying electronic-bin data included duration and feed consumption; these fields are absent from this Kaggle archive. Do not attach the socialh R-package enriched table to this CSV without proving row-level lineage.

The article reports 37 animals; the inspected Kaggle version contains 38 distinct animal IDs, including one ID with a single event. Treat this as an unresolved coverage discrepancy, not an automatically valid animal cohort.
The paper used a 0-10 second replacement threshold illustratively and explicitly recommends determining a breed/category-specific interval. It is not a ground-truth social label.

datasets.title: A Dataset on Nelore Cattle Supplementation in the Midwest Region of Brazil for Integrated Analysis of Supplementation, Satellite Remote Sensing, and Weather Variables

primary_publication.title: A dataset on Nelore Cattle supplementation in the midwest region of Brazil for integrated analysis of supplementation, satellite remote sensing, and weather variables

datasets.access: Public landing page and CC BY 4.0 metadata observed; files not copied into this repository.

study.animal_type: male Nelore, approximately 20 months at start
study.site: one 16 ha Brachiaria decumbens paddock, UFMS school farm

Complete_Dataset.csv: Table_1 animal, interval, weight, supplement and feeder variables

limitations: 26 animals in a single paddock and season; observational cohort, not a randomized supplement contrast
vegetation indices are not forage mass or forage chemistry; paper explicitly notes this proxy limitation
published rows aggregate 13-28 day intervals; avoid treating copied weather/vegetation period values as independent animal measurements

datasets.title: Data on: Shade provision and its influence on water consumption and drinking behaviour of Nellore cattle in feedlot in a tropical environment

primary_publication.title: Shade provision and its influence on water intake and drinking behaviour of Nellore cattle in feedlot in a tropical environment

datasets.access: Landing page lists Download All and CC BY 4.0. DataCite metadata also carries an embargoedAccess rights URI; file-level download/access state and worksheet schemas were not verified here.

study.treatment: artificial shade (+S) versus no shade (-S), applied to two pens per treatment

known_variables: individual water intake, visit time and duration
air temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, solar radiation, temperature-humidity index
limitations: shade treatment is allocated at group/pen level, with only four pens; animal records do not constitute 47 independent treatment replicates
treatment-level causal estimates require pen-aware analysis and careful uncertainty; avoid animal-level pseudoreplication
one water trough was located in the sunny area of each pen
feedlot total mixed ration is not extensive grazing
